name: Rendering & Landscape Design Cost Data
description: Structured, source-attributed pricing data for 3D architectural rendering and landscape design in the United States. Brand-attributed prices are real published prices; industry ranges are labelled as such.

items.notes: One watermarked AI concept of your own yard; no card.
3 full-resolution AI concepts of your own yard + plant list checked for your USDA hardiness zone.
Adds a to-scale 2D plan set (PDF) and DXF file; dimensions estimated, verify on site.
Adds named US products with quantities and price ranges.
Adds a budget range, contractor-hiring help and a $100 credit toward a human-designer design.

turnaround.homeowners: minutes (concept design only; not for construction or permit)

architecturalRenderingRanges.label: Typical US market ranges (industry survey, not a specific studio quote)

costFactors.effect: Photoreal materials, lighting and post-production cost more than draft/clay renders.
Each additional camera angle is priced separately in most studios.
Animation (video walkthroughs) costs many times more than a still due to per-frame rendering.
Large sites, dense planting, water features and crowds add modeling and render time.
Clean CAD/BIM or measured drawings reduce cost; vague sketches add modeling time.
Rush jobs carry a premium; standard turnaround is typically 5-10 days.
More included revision rounds raise the base price.
